annotations.text:
MAIN VIEW — the 30-second answer.
Line 1 is the pick. Everything else is supporting detail you can skip.
Left rail: board with drafted players struck through.
Right rail: strategy branch + roster holes colored by urgency.

TIER BOARD — positional scarcity at a glance.
Columns per position, tier bands inside each.
Gone players are X'd and struck through, tagged with who took them.
Red CLIFF bars mark real drop-offs. Roster needs bottom-right: red = critical, amber = act soon, grey = can wait.
